text: Given valid credentials and no filters, When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then it returns the standard list envelope and each item has id, first_name, last_name, email, organization_id and title.
Given organization_id and email are passed, When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then they are forwarded as filter[organization_id] and filter[email] on the GET /contacts request.

Given name, first_name, last_name and contact_type_id are passed, When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then each is forwarded as filter[name], filter[first_name], filter[last_name] and filter[contact_type_id].
Given sort="-updated_at", When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then the sort query parameter is forwarded unchanged to IT Glue (no local validation, matching every other list tool).

Given an organization has more contacts than fit on one page, When the caller walks the result with next_offset, Then every contact is returned exactly once and a page IT Glue cuts short continues exactly where it stopped.
notes: Covered by adding ("itglue_list_contacts", "/contacts", {}) to the shared LISTS table in tests/test_paging_offset.py; no new test code needed beyond the table entry.

text: Given the X-ITGlue-API-Key header is absent, When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "not_configured", ...}}, not an exception.
notes: Inherited generic coverage: this shared test already exercises every tool (including itglue_list_contacts once registered) through the common run()/ITGlueClient path; no per-tool duplicate needed.

text: Given IT Glue returns 429 then 200, When itglue_list_contacts is called, Then it retries once (honouring Retry-After) and returns the successful envelope; given IT Glue returns 403, it returns {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false}}.
notes: Inherited generic coverage via the shared run()/ITGlueClient.request() error-mapping path, same as every other tool; no per-tool duplicate needed.

text: Given tools/list is queried, When itglue_list_contacts is registered, Then it is present with readOnlyHint: true, no agent_id parameter, is listed in README.md's Tools table, and every previously-registered tool is still present with its previous parameters.
notes: Covered by adding the itglue_list_contacts entry to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json and bumping the two hardcoded tools/list counts in tests/test_middleware.py from 37 to 38; no new test code needed beyond those two edits.
